images.alt:
A handwritten flip chart sheet titled "CYBER INCIDENTS + DM role" detailing strategies for incident response and team management.
The main key points and sections include:
 * Header Principles (Green):
   * Be transparent: What happened + why.
   * Clear roles + responsibilities: Know when to adapt these.
   * Keep people protected + focused on the right priorities.
   * Keep calm: Provide support for those who might have accidentally caused the issue.
   * Be proactive with your comms.
 * Key Takeaways & Actions:
   * Exclamation icon (Black): "The 'lurkers' can be helpful. Deploy them on X, Y, Z tasks."
   * Practice (Red): "Practice with 'Chaos days' with test situation (ideally once a quarter)".
   * Role of a DM (Blue & Green): "A DM can facilitate the creation of a plan & ensure lessons learnt are captured (both during the live incident + afterwards)."
   * Frameworks & Guidance (Green & Blue): "Cynefin framework (chaos) can help" and "Identify which cyber experts can help."
   * Wellbeing & Management (Red & Blue): "Be firm when people need to stop working, so that they don't burnout." "Recovery is a long game."
   * Planning (Green): "Try + have mapped it out in preparation for what if a service goes down, where do users go?"
   * Retro/Reflection (Teal): "RETRO/REFLECTION WHEN THE DANGER/RISK HAS REDUCED."
   * Self-Care & Resources (Red):
     * "Resource: 'Hacking Google' on YouTube"
     * "DMs also need to protect themselves -> give yourself a mental break / Get help + support from your peers"
